title: The birthdays of children
simplified_paragraphs: 我和我的好朋友都有孩子，我有一个女儿，她有一个儿子。我的女儿在2017年2月16日星期四出生。朋友的儿子生日是6月30日。他的生日快到了，不知道他想要什么礼物呢？
traditional_paragraphs: 我和我的好朋友都有孩子，我有一個女兒，她有一個兒子。我的女兒在2017年2月16日星期四出生。朋友的兒子生日是6月30日。他的生日快到了，不知道他想要什麼禮物呢？
pinyin_paragraphs: wǒ hé wǒ de hǎo péng you dōu yǒu hái zi， wǒ yǒu yī gè nǚ ér， tā yǒu yī gè ér zi。 wǒ de nǚ ér zài 2017 nián 2 yuè 16 rì Xīng qī sì chū shēng。 péng you de ér zi shēng rì shì 6 yuè 30 rì。 tā de shēng rì kuài dào le， bù zhī dào tā xiǎng yào shén me lǐ wù ne？
english_paragraphs: My good friend and I both have children. I have a daughter, and she has a son. My daughter was born on Thursday, February 16, 2017. My friend’s son’s birthday is June 30. His birthday is coming up soon. I wonder what gift he would like?
english_full: My good friend and I both have children. I have a daughter, and she has a son. My daughter was born on Thursday, February 16, 2017. My friend’s son’s birthday is June 30. His birthday is coming up soon. I wonder what gift he would like?
